rationale: The entry premise required price below both VWAP and the 5m 9-EMA, but VRT has reclaimed the 9-EMA ($208.50) and is grinding up with higher 1m lows (207.77→208.32→208.40→208.65), so the seller-control read is no longer clean. With price essentially flat at entry and the $209.25 invalidation only ~0.3% away — inside one 5m ATR of noise — the edge has deteriorated and I prefer to exit near breakeven rather than risk a random stop-out.
